newsitem.title: UK: New World unit prices $300 mln conv bond.
newsitem.headline: New World unit prices $300 mln conv bond.

text.p: New World China Finance Ltd has given a 4.00 percent coupon to its $300 million par-priced convertible bond due December 1999, lead manager HSBC Investment Bank Asia said on Wednesday.
The bonds are mandatorily convertible into shares in New World China Finance on the occasion of any initial public offering of the shares on or before December 31, 1999.
The conversion price will be set at a minimum discount of six percent to the IPO pricing.
New World China Finance is a wholly-owned unit of New World Development Co Ltd.
An IPO was expected within three years, HSBC said.
The redemption price was set at 111.645 to yield 140 basis points over U.S. Treasuries.
